CONTROLS.NAME: dither_mod
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Affects the dither. Low will be fewer bright pixels, high will be no dithering at all.

CONTROLS.NAME: size
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets the size of the pixels for the dither effect.

CONTROLS.NAME: pattern_mixer
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mixes between two patterns: low is the simple shapes, high is the smooth gradient shape with lots of motion.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_1
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Define one of the two colors that make up the palette.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_2
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Define the second color. Most colors will fall between these two, but will always be more heavily saturated.
